name: Sports Court
design_intent:
SPORTS pitch (docs/specs/v5_sports_mode.md §5). A SYMMETRIC, two-goal, all-bouncy enclosed court for the bounce-ball mode: NO flat standable ground (a full-width TRAMPOLINE floor keeps players + ball in constant motion, Pillar 2), bumper side walls with a mid-height GOAL MOUTH each end, a goal_zone just inside each mouth (team:0 left / team:1 right) with a bumper BACK WALL behind it so a scored ball can't leave bounds, a bumper CEILING to seal the top, and two free-standing bumpers for carom chaos. Zero powerup_spawners (disables the powerup director, TRIALS' trick).

FLIGHT GATE (GAME_ESSENCE Rule A): the pitch is CENTER x=1400. End spawns sit at x=500/700 (left) and x=2100/2300 (right); the ball kicks off at centre (1400, ~800). Nearest-spawn-to-centre horizontal distance is 700px (x700->1400) and 900px (x500->1400), and centre-to-goal is ~1160px (x1400->x240). Both exceed the 527px max spring drift and far exceed the 395px trampoline drift, so reaching the ball at centre and pressing it to the far goal REQUIRE boost (a zero-boost bounce-hop falls short). Movement is load-bearing, not scenery. kill_shape 'sports_court' is cosmetic (enclosed pitch, players never ring out into a void; high lives respawn any rare escape).

GEOMETRY: interior x290..2510, floor top y=1350 (trampoline), ceiling bottom y=210 (bumper). Left wall x200..290 split into y210..650 + y950..1350, leaving a 300px goal mouth at y650..950; left back wall x60..140 seals the pocket; goal_zone (team 0, RED defends) centred x=240 y=800 140x300. Right side mirrored (right wall x2510..2600, back wall x2660..2740, goal_zone team 1 x=2560). Two interior bumpers, MIRROR-SYMMETRIC about centre (x1000 y380 and its mirror x1660 y380), reshape airborne lines between centre and each goal. They sit at the SAME height so the court is a true left/right mirror under gravity: the earlier point-symmetric layout (one high-left, one low-right) systematically deflected rightward drives while leaving the left goal's low lane open, funnelling the ball into the LEFT goal and handing team 1 (BLUE) a reliable blowout in bot-vs-bot play. A vertical-axis mirror REQUIRES both bumpers at the same y. Bounds 0..2800 x, 0..1600 y enclose everything. WK-122: each goal back wall is a short BACK POST spanning the mouth +-100px (was full height = a doubled pillar column outside the court); the 60px slot between it and the post column is narrower than any goat (r >= 39.6) or the ball (r 60), so the pocket stays sealed (WK-122 probe, 100 s of bot play on CENTER PITCH, LONG HAUL and THE BOX: no goat or ball left the mouth band; the other five share the CENTER PITCH pocket).
